verdict.rationale: Ramp's first-party webhooks guide says webhooks push real-time event notifications to a developer-specified endpoint instead of requiring polling. The llms.txt index names webhooks the canonical surface for event-driven workflows such as large transactions, bill approvals, card issuance and status changes, handled by a service like Lambda or Cloud Run. Missing for 10: documented subscription/registration mechanics (API or UI for creating webhook subscriptions), a full event-type catalog, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
